descriptions.text: Make your own color spritzer! Fill this empty bottle with water or rubbing alcohol and any color of Classic Stampin' Ink, then mix and spritz. Great for spritzing large areas. * 2 bottles

images.description: A spray bottle with a white pump cap containing purple liquid is displayed alongside a gradient purple glitter cardstock sheet. The spray product features a clear cylindrical bottle with a white label band, and the cardstock transitions from light lavender to deeper purple with a shimmering finish.

descriptions.text: Protect work surfaces as you paper pierce. Also get even pressure and ink coverage with detailed or background stamps. Buy 1 for piercing and 1 for stamping! * 1 mat * 6-1/2" x 9-1/2" (16.5 x 24.1 cm)

images.description: A rectangular gray fabric or felt mat with a smooth, textured surface and clean edges. A small white rectangular Stampin' Up logo label is visible in the lower right corner. The product appears to be a work surface or protective mat displayed against a light neutral background.

descriptions.text: Keep your stamps squeaky clean with Stampin' Scrub. Stampin' Scrub has two trays with plush black fiber scrub pads. Spray Stampin' Mist Cleaner on one side and scrub stamps; dry stamps on the other pad. The fibers ensure that even the most detailed stamps come clean. Use with Stampin' Mist cleaner. Folds when not in use. * Pad size: 7" x 7" (18.4 x 18.4 cm) * Large enough to clean background stamps * Hold 2 removable, washable scrubbing pads (included)

images.description: Two black rectangular storage cases or containers with metallic silver/gray trim and hinged closure, positioned open side-by-side on a light neutral background. The cases appear to be organized storage solutions with a felt or velvet interior lining.
